duplication_audit.novel_axis: deterministic level-2 ordered iterated integrals over a causal multivariate path
duplication_audit.distinction: NLinear uses fixed lags and summaries; spectral uses unordered Fourier amplitudes and random features; TCN/TimeXer/masked-SSL/state-space learn discrete or latent encoders. This cycle uses no deep net and no learned path encoder: its only new information representation is deterministic ordered cross-channel path geometry.
closed_families_unchanged: TCN and TimeXer direct six-lead heads
v13-v22 alpha, router, residual, ERA5, robust fallback, and reduced-rank proposals

path.augmentation: normalized time plus five linearly filled physical channels plus five observed-mask channels
path.missing_rule: case-local linear interpolation between observed past values; nearest endpoint fill; all-missing channel zero; explicit mask retained
path.signature_formula: piecewise-linear Chen signature: level1 increments and ordered level2 iterated integrals
path.static_features: five scaled current endpoints plus station one-hot

model.target: six-lead target_hs minus exact uniform alpha 0.425 reference
model.train_fold_scaler: median and IQR, clip standardized features to [-8,8]

validation.surface: EXPLORATORY_ONLY repeatedly exposed 182 complete historical cases
validation.gate: delta RMSE below zero, at least 4/6 blocks improve, episode and block-station CI90 upper below zero, worst station-lead <=0.01m
